description: MainActivity class of an Android application managing notes with bottom navigation, drawer for note details, and category management.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity for handling UI and interactions in the notes app, including navigation, note editing, and category management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI components, fragments, and data repository.

methods.name: setupBottomNavigation
methods.description: Configures bottom navigation item selection listener.

methods.name: setupFab
methods.description: Configures Floating Action Button to create new notes.

methods.name: setupDrawerButtons
methods.description: Sets click listeners for the drawer's control buttons.

methods.name: switchFragment
methods.description: Switches between different UI fragments based on navigation.

methods.name: refreshCategoriesIntoSpinner
methods.description: Reloads categories from repository into the category spinner.

methods.name: resetDrawerFor
methods.description: Prepares the drawer UI for creating or editing a note.

methods.name: ensureCategoriesSeeded
methods.description: Ensures that some default categories exist in the repository.

methods.name: openNoteDrawer
methods.description: Opens the drawer in create/edit mode for notes.

methods.name: closeDrawer
methods.description: Closes the note detail drawer.

methods.name: saveNoteFromDrawer
methods.description: Validates input and saves or updates a note in the repository.

methods.name: deleteCurrentNote
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note.

methods.name: shareCurrentNote
methods.description: Shares the current note through an intent.

methods.name: refreshCurrentScreen
methods.description: Refreshes the displayed fragment based on current data.

methods.name: showKeyboard
methods.description: Brings up the soft keyboard for a view.

methods.name: hideKeyboard
methods.description: Hides the soft keyboard if open.

methods.name: onNoteSelected
methods.description: Callback when a note is selected from a fragment.

methods.name: onAddCategoryRequested
methods.description: Callback to initiate adding a new category.

methods.name: onCategorySelected
methods.description: Callback when a category is selected from the categories fragment.

methods.name: selectBottomTab
methods.description: Programmatically switches bottom navigation tab.
